subject: Request: Incident Response runbook + sample alert exports for SIG mapping
messages:
From: Elena Flores <elena.flores@capitol-fin.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: IR runbook + sample alert exports for SIG mapping

Hi Tessa,

We're updating our vendor SIG mappings and need a few artifacts from Redwood to complete closure on the IR/forensics section (SIG v2.1 and CAIQ crosswalk). Can you provide:

- A redacted excerpt of your Incident Response runbook that shows detection/triage/playbook activation steps (preferably PDF).
- A sample alert export (CSV) covering a 48-hour window that we can use to validate chain-of-custody and logging retention claims (redacted/hashed as needed).
- A short mapping or index (CSV or spreadsheet) that points which runbook sections or artifacts map to SIG/CAIQ control statements.

If there are pieces you cannot share, please indicate what evidence we could request instead (e.g., SOC 2 control matrix references, signed attestation, timeline review). We are hoping to complete our SIG review by 2027-05-31 — is that feasible?

Thanks,
Elena Flores
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
Capitol Financial

Attachment: SIG_Mapping_Template_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
To: Elena Flores <elena.flores@capitol-fin.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-23T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IR runbook + sample alert exports for SIG mapping

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the template. We can provide a redacted runbook excerpt and a sample alert export with PII/tenant identifiers hashed. Quick questions so we prepare exactly what you need:

1) For the alert export: do you need full raw logs or the alert aggregation CSV (one row per alert with metadata)? The former is larger and may require transfer via SFTP.
2) For redactions: is hashing acceptable for tenant IDs and user IDs, or do you require full redaction?
3) For mapping: we can deliver a SIG index CSV that points to sections in the runbook and to SOC2 control IDs — will that work?

Tentative timeline: we can get a redacted runbook excerpt + mapping to you within 48 hours and an alert-export (redacted) within 72 hours, delivered via a secure Drive link or SFTP based on your preference. If that meets your cutoff (2027-05-31) we will proceed.

I'll loop in Marissa (security ops) and Karthik (forensics) to prep artifacts.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-23T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Request: IR runbook + sample alert exports for SIG mapping (Capitol Financial)

Marissa / Karthik — see request from Capitol Financial (attached template). Scope: redacted IR runbook excerpt, SIG index, and a 48-hour alert-export with tenant/user hashing.

Please action:
- Marissa: prepare a redacted PDF excerpt (detection -> triage -> containment steps). Aim for 3–4 pages max. Include references to SOC2 control IDs where applicable.
- Karthik: generate a sample alert-export for 2027-05-20 00:00 to 2027-05-21 23:59. Hash tenant_id and user_id with SHA256 and include a short readme describing redaction method. CSV columns should be: alert_id, timestamp, rule_name, severity, tenant_hash, user_hash, artifact_refs.

Delivery plan: send the runbook + SIG_evidence_index.csv and SOC2 control matrix reference to me for review by EOD 2027-05-24. Karthik, aim to have the alert-export ready by 2027-05-24 11:00 PT so I can include it in the deliverable. If SFTP is needed for the CSV, note it here.

Thanks — this is a pretty standard SIG ask but they want the 48-hour sample to validate our telemetry export process.

—Tessa
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
To: Elena Flores <elena.flores@capitol-fin.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-24T11:38:00-07:00
Subject: Deliverables: redacted IR excerpt + sample alert export (Capitol Financial)

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the patience — attached is the package requested for SIG mapping. Deliverables included below and via secure Drive (link at the bottom).

Attachments (stubs):
- IR_Runbook_Redacted_v1.pdf (PDF, 3 pages) — redacted excerpt covering detection, triage, escalation, and playbook activation. References SOC2 CC4.1 / CC6.2 where applicable.
- alert-export-20270520_20270521.csv (CSV, ~4.2 MB) — sample alerts for the 48-hour window; tenant_id and user_id hashed with SHA256. Readme included as first worksheet row describing the hashing salt/generator name.
- SIG_evidence_index.csv (CSV) — index mapping runbook sections and artifact filenames to SIG and CAIQ control statements (columns: artifact, runbook_section, sig_control, caiq_control, notes).
- SOC2_Control_Matrix.pdf (PDF) — control matrix snapshot showing how the IR procedures map to SOC2 control IDs (redacted to remove internal user names).

Notes:
- We redacted tenant identifiers per our standard vendor disclosure process; hashing method documented in the CSV readme.
- If you require raw logs for a specific alert for a deeper forensics review, we can arrange an SFTP transfer under an executed NDA/DP Agreement.

Next steps: happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through the mapping. Proposed slots: 2027-05-25 09:00–10:00 PT or 2027-05-25 13:00–13:30 PT. Let me know which works.

Drive link (secure, expires 2027-06-07): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example-drive-link

Best,
